# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger is a parrot featuring wicked golden eyes and tail feathers. He possesses green and gold plumage, which he can ruffle up until he resembles a ball.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036), [v2 IX A Question of Color P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022)_

## Personality

Ginger is a highly imitative parrot known for profane speech and swearing habits that prove difficult to break. Naturally suspicious, Ginger consistently greets others with sarcastic remarks.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P38](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0038), [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_
